escena: SCENE (choosing between versions, design studio in Santiago, morning, NO faces): THE SUBJECT OF THE PHOTOGRAPH IS THE CHOICE — verify it by these landmarks: NINE printed sheets of THE SAME PIECE are pinned in a grid on a pale studio wall, and they are almost identical: the same layout, the same image, differing only in tiny things — a slightly different weight of type, a crop a few millimetres tighter, one field of ink-blue a shade cooler. ONE of the nine is physically SEPARATED from the grid: pulled forward off the wall, hanging by a single pin, with an ORANGE grease-pencil circle drawn on its corner. A hard shaft of window light rakes across the whole grid at the instant a hand at the frame edge releases that sheet and it swings. The near-identical repetition is what the picture is about: not the piece, but the decision between nine versions of it. A hand and forearm may enter from the edge, no face. 50mm at f/4. Everything is completely unbranded, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the out-of-focus corner of a dark walnut worktop entering at the bottom of the frame
